protocols.modbus_tcp_desc: Read Modbus register data via Ethernet network, the most common industrial communication standard.
protocols.modbus_rtu_desc: Bi-directional half-duplex communication with PLCs and sensors via RS-485/RS-232 serial ports.
protocols.modbus_udp_desc: Transfer Modbus protocol using connectionless UDP packets, suitable for high frequency but packet-loss tolerant environments.
protocols.fatek_fbs_desc: Fatek FBs series PLC proprietary communication protocol, supporting registers and discrete points read/write.
protocols.mc_3e_desc: Mitsubishi Electric Q/L/FX series PLC Ethernet MC protocol 3E frame, supporting device data read/write.
protocols.mqtt_desc: Lightweight publish/subscribe messaging protocol, suitable for IoT and cloud data integration.
